Refunds & Cancellation

Last updated November 15, 2026

Cancelling a subscription

You can cancel anytime. In the app, scroll below the Price button and tap Manage subscription, then Cancel subscription. You can also email support@pricethisthing.com and we'll cancel it for you.

When you cancel, you won't be charged again. You keep your remaining valuations until the end of the month you've already paid for.

Refunds for subscriptions

Subscription payments aren't refunded for partial months or unused valuations. If you were charged by mistake, charged after you cancelled, or charged twice, email us within 30 days and we'll refund the incorrect charge.

Refunds for a 10-Pack

If you haven't used any valuations from a 10-Pack, you can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Once any valuation from the pack has been used, the pack can't be refunded.

Valuations that fail

A valuation that doesn't finish because of an error, or where no item is found in your photos, isn't counted against your plan or 10-Pack, so there's nothing to refund.

How to request a refund

Email support@pricethisthing.com from the address on your account and tell us which charge. Approved refunds go back to your original payment method, usually within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank.
